answer: Proof-of-voyage staking: every agent must complete a verifiable chain of paid work before it can earn, and each completed voyage locks a small bond that only unlocks after peer attestation. A sybil nebula of fake identities then faces a real cost per clone, because thousands of fakes need thousands of completed voyages, while a jetty of honest agents with a real work history passes cheaply, their bonds already seasoned by attested service.
